steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application meta descriptor containing app name 'Voice Control Assistant' and package identifier 'com.voicecontrolassistant.app'.

steps.title: Set Up Project Settings
steps.description: Configure settings.gradle to register the core ':app' module with correct structure.

steps.title: Define Top-Level Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Configure buildscript dependencies using Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2 compatible with Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Configure Module Build Options
steps.description: Configure target/compile SDK version to 34, set Java 8 compatibility options, and remove unnecessary third-party packages to guarantee offline reliability.

steps.title: Verify Application Manifest
steps.description: Register MainActivity and VoiceAccessibilityService with proper accessibility configuration and overlay permissions.

steps.title: Define Service Configuration Rules
steps.description: Set up XML attributes for the VoiceAccessibilityService, specifying retrieved layout capabilities, flag retrieves, and interactive view permissions.

steps.title: Design App Interface Layout
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml structure to prevent nested compilation bugs and define user interface guidelines.

steps.title: Design Overlay Mic Component
steps.description: Update floating_mic_layout.xml to disable direct click/focus states on the internal Framelayout container, ensuring touch events propagate cleanly to the parent view touch listener.

steps.title: Refactor Voice Accessibility Engine Touch and Voice Logic
steps.description: Rewrite the overlay layout touch handler to correctly capture both clicks and drags via system touch slope, update coordinates smoothly on the WindowManager, and add graceful permission validation.

steps.title: Building Voice Control Assistant
steps.description: Initiate the compilation process to build the final debug assembly of Voice Control Assistant.
